conditions.name: Fever (acute & chronic)
conditions.description: Febrile states classified by dosha involvement and periodicity; vishamajwara denotes irregular, relapsing fevers.
conditions.ip_notes: Antipyretic uses of tulsi and neem decoctions are TKDL-documented prior art against modern therapeutic patents.

conditions.name: Breathing difficulty / Asthma-like states
conditions.description: Five types of dyspnoea described in Charaka Sutrasthana 17, from exertional to critical (maha shwasa).
conditions.ip_notes: Adhatoda vasika + pippali combinations for shwasa are classic TKDL citations used in USPTO rejections.

conditions.name: Joint degeneration / Osteoarthritis
conditions.description: Vata-aggravation in the joints with ama involvement; distinguishes degenerative (sandhivata) vs inflammatory (amavata).
conditions.ip_notes: Boswellia serrata standardization patents coexist with TKDL-documented guggulu yogas for sandhivata.

conditions.name: Skin disorders
conditions.description: Seven types of skin disease in classical texts, spanning dry/exudative and inherited/acquired forms.
conditions.ip_notes: Turmeric's wound/skin utility was the basis of the landmark 1997 US patent revocation that created TKDL.

conditions.name: Sugar-balance disorder
conditions.description: Twenty types of prameha; madhumeha (honey-urine) maps closest to diabetes mellitus in modern reading.
conditions.ip_notes: Fenugreek and gymnema glucose-management uses documented in TKDL blocked several 'novel use' patent applications at EPO/USPTO.

conditions.name: Obesity / Lipid disorders
conditions.description: Disorders of meda dhatu (fat tissue), linked to kapha accumulation and mandagni (low digestive fire).
conditions.ip_notes: Guggulu-based lipid formulations sit at the intersection of TKDL prior art and modern phytopharmaceutical patent strategy.

conditions.name: Piles / Hemorrhoids
conditions.description: Four types based on predominant dosha; associated with mandagni and dviguna kapha-mala accumulation.
conditions.ip_notes: Kasisadi and triphala-based arsha preparations are Schedule T classical entries with TKDL-backed composition art.
